in_latin.name: Eliza
in_latin.meaning: Derived from Hebrew name Elisheva, meaning 'God is my oath', and Greek name Eliza, meaning 'my God is abundance'
in_latin.long_meaning: Eliza, a feminine given name, derives from Hebrew name Elisheva, meaning 'God is my oath', and Greek name Eliza, meaning 'my God is abundance'. In Christian tradition, Eliza signifies devotion, loyalty, and faithfulness. The name is also associated with the biblical figure of Elizabeth, a righteous woman and relative of John the Baptist.
